'''Arsenio''' is an NPC located in {{Location|Etching Plains|nocat=1}} who will accept [[Tape of Last Words|Tapes of Last Words]] in exchange for various rewards.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Etching Plains|Arsenio}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Arsenio}} 
{{Dialogue start}}
==WavesLine==
:'''Arsenio:''' The Exostrider's fall was no silent affair. The Reactor Drive's glow pierced the darkness, and the warm frequency echoes in the air to this day.
:'''Arsenio:''' Your Terminal has captured a warm afterglow—this is no coincidence. After all, similar frequencies are known to be drawn to each other.
:'''Arsenio:''' Fellow bearer of an identical frequency, my name is Arsenio. Would you be willing to accept my invitation to our camp?
:{{DIcon}} Sure, I'll head over right away.
::'''Arsenio:''' Thank you for accepting my invitation. I'll send you the coordinates shortly. 
:{{DIcon}} I'm a little busy right now. I'll head over when I have the time.
::'''Arsenio:''' I appreciate the response. Perhaps I could send the coordinates to you in advance, and you may visit anytime as you please.
:;Quest Accepted - {{Quest|Purify the Tapes of Last Words}}

==Dialogue==
:{{DIcon}} I want to deliver Tapes of Last Words
:;(Opens Tape of Last Words delivery interface)
:'''Arsenio:''' I cleanse the contamination from the Tape of Last Words to restore the unfinished whispers of those lost to the winds... Such is the burden I carry.
:;(Deliver Tapes of Last Words)
:'''Arsenio:''' 
:;(If the player tries to deliver Tapes of Last Words without any in their backpack)
:'''Arsenio:''' Fear not. My spirit and body are one, and they will carry me through this task... until the final moment.
----
;(Collecting a certain threshold of Tapes)
:'''Abby:''' We've collected plenty of Tapes of Last Words. Ohhh... I can't watch Arsenio keep hurting itself like that, but the way it's determined to fulfill it's duties... Let's bring them over quick!
{{Dialogue end}}
